recognize_zh: 這是低腫瘤負荷濾泡性淋巴瘤（LTB-FL）的處置流程圖（非形態學影像）：依年齡 70 歲分流，兩組皆可選擇觀察等待（W&W）或考慮 rituximab；年輕者在出現高腫瘤負荷（HTB）時開始 R-化療，年長者若進展則在達高腫瘤負荷前先給 rituximab。
features: Decision tree starting from low-tumor-burden follicular lymphoma (LTB FL)
First branch by age: younger than 70 versus 70 or older
Age younger than 70: watch and wait or consider rituximab; initiate R-chemotherapy upon development of high tumor burden
Age 70 or older: watch and wait or consider rituximab
Age 70 or older on watch and wait: continue if no progression; if progression, initiate rituximab before high tumor burden develops
describe_en: This non-morphologic figure is a suggested management algorithm for low-tumor-burden follicular lymphoma. Patients are first divided by age (younger than 70 versus 70 or older), and in both groups watch and wait or single-agent rituximab are acceptable initial options. Younger patients under observation start rituximab-chemotherapy when high tumor burden develops, whereas older patients under observation continue watch and wait if there is no progression but receive rituximab at progression before high tumor burden is reached, avoiding chemotherapy toxicity. The algorithm reflects the lack of survival benefit from early treatment in asymptomatic disease.
